blocks.title: if you have *10,000* Manychat contacts and nobody buys, this is why

blocks.caption: it's a rule most coaches never read.

blocks.text: when a lead messages you on Instagram or Messenger, a 24-hour window opens. inside it, you can reply freely, even with an offer.
each new message from the lead gives you 24 more hours. the chat stays open while they keep talking.
automated messages aren't allowed anymore. Manychat won't send your scheduled ones once the window closes.
not from Manychat. every tool on Meta's official API plays by the same window.
it answers while the lead is talking and sends up to 3 follow-ups, between 1 and 23 hours after their last message.

list: no lead goes cold at hour 25.
every follow-up stays inside Meta's rules.
the sale happens while they're talking.
your contacts finally hear from you, legally.

cta.line: and i'll show you how to set up your AI setter for free.
